name: Energy and Heating System Collapse
title: Ukraine · Energy and Heating System Collapse

definition.question: How close is Ukraine's energy and heating system to total failure ahead of winter?
definition.low_end: Grid stable with ample dispatchable generation, import buffers and district heating fully operational through winter.
definition.high_end: Nationwide grid collapse with prolonged blackouts and loss of district heating leaving millions without power or warmth in freezing temperatures.

readings.rationale: Virtually no intact thermal plants, ~90% thermal generation destroyed, ~50% hydro damaged, capacity <10 GW vs 18 GW winter demand (from 38 GW pre-war), 423 attacks on electricity +74 on heating Oct 2025-Mar 2026, 60% gas production destroyed requiring 4.4 bcm imports ($2.5bn), and OHCHR assessment that full restoration before next winter is impossible. Higher if nuclear plants are severed from…

New 26-30 Sep strikes on Trypillya TPP/Kyivska substation/Kyiv HPP confirm start of winter 2026-27 campaign but are a vivid incident inside the pattern the last reading already priced in. No evidence capacity fell below 8GW or prolonged heating loss in major cities…
